FULLMOONKNIGHT-STRIKE.title: Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEFEND.title: Defend
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PIERCING_STRIKE.title: Piercing Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PIERCING_STRIKE.descripti:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} [gold]Piercing[/gold] damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for every 4 [gold]Block[/gold] you have.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHORTSWORD.title: Shortsword
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHORTSWORD.description: Every 2 Attacks you play, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy (at most 3 times per turn).
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EXECUTE.title: Execute
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EXECUTE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target is below {Threshold}% HP, deal {ExecuteDamage:diff()} damage instead.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WRATH_STRIKE.title: Wrath Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WRATH_STRIKE.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold] damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for every 4 HP you have lost.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STORM_STRIKE.title: Storm Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STORM_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Thunder[/gold] damage to ALL enemies.
Your Attacks deal {InspiredPower:diff()} additional damage this turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FLINCH.title: Flinch
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FLINCH.description: When an enemy attacks: negate it and draw {Cards:diff()} more {Cards:plural:card|cards} next turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ROUND_SHIELD.title: Round Shield
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ROUND_SHIELD.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CLOWN_TRICK.title: Clown Trick
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RIPOSTE.title: Riposte
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RIPOSTE.description: When an enemy attacks: negate it, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it and draw {Cards:diff()} more {Cards:plural:card|cards} next turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STARE.title: Stare
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STARE.description: When an enemy attacks: negate it and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to it.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DISORIENT.title: Disorient
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DISORIENT.description:
When an enemy acts without attacking: negate it and [gold]Steal[/gold] its effects.
Draw {Cards:diff()} more {Cards:plural:card|cards} next turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RESONANCE.title: Resonance
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RESONANCE.description:
When an enemy acts: negate it and [gold]Steal[/gold] its effects. Its attack damage is reflected back at it.{IfUpgraded:show:
Draw {Cards:diff()} more {Cards:plural:card|cards} next turn.|}
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DESPERATE_FIGHT.title: Desperate Fight
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STAB.title: Stab
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ABSOLUTE_DEFENSE.title: Absolute Defense

FULLMOONKNIGHT-BOMB.title: Bomb
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FIRECRACKERS.title: Firecrackers
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FIRECRACKERS.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]Fire[/gold] damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BRAVE_HEART.title: Brave Heart
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BRAVE_HEART.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Add a random {IfUpgraded:show:Upgraded |}[gold]Temporary[/gold] Attack into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PUNCH.title: Punch
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PUNCH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]Temporary[/gold] [gold]Strike+[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FINE_COLLECTION.title: Fine Collection
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FINE_COLLECTION.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add a random [gold]Temporary[/gold] [gold]Equipment[/gold] card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CLOSE_QUARTERS.title: Close Quarters
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CLOCKWORK_HORSE.title: Clockwork Horse
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CLOCKWORK_HORSE.descripti: At the end of your turn, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy and gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SWIFT_STRIKE.title: Swift Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CONCENTRATE.title: Concentrate

FULLMOONKNIGHT-SOUL_STRIKE.title: Soul Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SOUL_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], raise your Max HP by {MaxHp:diff()}.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HOLY_STRIKE.title: Holy Strike
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HOLY_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Heal HP equal to half the unblocked damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-THOUSAND_CUTS.title: Thousand Cuts
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RAM.title: Ram
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RAM.description:
Deal damage equal to {Percent:diff()}% of your current HP, with a minimum base damage of {MinDamage:diff()}.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEADLY_ARSENAL.title: Deadly Arsenal
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEADLY_ARSENAL.descriptio: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage once for each [gold]Equipment[/gold] you have.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SPIKED_SHIELD.title: Spiked Shield
FULLMOONKNIGHT-STONE_SKIN.title: Stone Skin

FULLMOONKNIGHT-OVEREXERT.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your draw pile (no reshuffle).
Gain {WearyPower:diff()} [gold]Weary[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HEAVY_CHOP.title: Heavy Chop
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TAUNT.title: Taunt
FULLMOONKNIGHT-LOYALTY.title: Loyalty
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GREED.title: Greed
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GREED.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Discard all non-Attack cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CARD_EXPRESS.title: Card Express
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CARD_EXPRESS.description: Draw cards until you have {Cards:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CONJURE.title: Conjure
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FEINT.title: Feint
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FEINT.description: Choose an Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Shuffle {Cards:diff()} [gold]Temporary[/gold] copies of it into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-INSPIRATION.title: Inspiration
FULLMOONKNIGHT-INSPIRATION.description: Choose 1 of {Cards:diff()} random cards. Add a [gold]Temporary[/gold] copy of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold] and shuffle 2 more into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHIELD_BLOCK.title: Shield Block
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHIELD_BLOCK.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
The leftmost Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold] becomes a copy of this card.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMPER.title: Temper
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMPER.description: Look at {Cards:diff()} random cards in your deck. Add a [gold]Temporary[/gold] copy of 1 of them into your [gold]Hand[/gold].

FULLMOONKNIGHT-SABOTAGE.title: Sabotage
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SABOTAGE.description:
Remove a random common buff (Strength, Dexterity, Artifact...) from the enemy.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-AUCTION_TICKET.title: Auction Ticket
FULLMOONKNIGHT-AUCTION_TICKET.descriptio:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Costs 1 less for each [gold]Equipment[/gold] you have.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRIM_BATTLE.title: Grim Battle
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRIM_BATTLE.description:
Shuffle a [gold]Temporary[/gold] copy of each Attack in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WHIRLWIND_AXE.title: Whirlwind Axe

FULLMOONKNIGHT-COMBO.title: Combo
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COMBO.description:
Play a copy of the last Attack you played.{IfUpgraded:show:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.|}
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EMERGENCY_RATIONS.title: Emergency Rations

FULLMOONKNIGHT-BACKUP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
After another Attack, return this from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TARARA.title: Ta-ra-ra-pu-ru-ru
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TARARA.description: Choose a combat skill to use: [gold]Combo[/gold], [gold]Tenacity[/gold] or [gold]Baptism[/gold].

FULLMOONKNIGHT-TARARA_BAPTISM.title: Baptism

FULLMOONKNIGHT-LEVEL_UP_ENERGY.title: Action

Choose 1 of {Cards:diff()} random cards to add to your deck permanently.
{Uses} {Uses:plural:use|uses} left; removed from your deck when used up.

FULLMOONKNIGHT-THUNDER_BLADE.title: Thunder Blade

FULLMOONKNIGHT-BERSERKER_AXE.description: After you play a [gold]Strike[/gold], add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Temporary[/gold] {Cards:plural:copy|copies} of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. These copies do not trigger Berserker Axe.

FULLMOONKNIGHT-BEAR_TRAP.description: Whenever an enemy attack hits you, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to it.

Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Trigger the start-of-turn effects of all your [gold]Equipment[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-INTERMISSION.title: Intermission
FULLMOONKNIGHT-INTERMISSION.description: After this turn, take another turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WOODCUTTER_AXE.title: Woodcutter Axe
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WOODCUTTER_AXE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, add {Cards:diff()} random [gold]Temporary[/gold] {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CHARGED_BLOW.title: Charged Blow
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DOUBLE_STRIKE.title: Double Strike

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your draw pile (no reshuffle).

FULLMOONKNIGHT-RASHOMON.title: Rashomon

FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEFT_MAGIC.title: Deft Magic

FULLMOONKNIGHT-FEARLESS.title: Fearless
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FEARLESS.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your draw pile (no reshuffle).
Gain {WearyPower:diff()} [gold]Weary[/gold].

FULLMOONKNIGHT-VAMPIRE_SWORD.title: Vampire Sword

FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLOW_CURSE.title: Slow

FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.CALAMITY: Does not trigger on attacks the Knight generated during combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.SUBROUTINE: Does not trigger on the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.STORM: Does not trigger on the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRANDMAS_BLESSING.title: Grandma's Blessing
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRANDMAS_BLESSING.descrip: Choose 1 of {Cards:diff()} cards to add to your hand.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRANDMAS_CRUTCH.title: Grandma's Crutch
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GRANDMAS_CRUTCH.descripti: Grandma's crutch? Who did she fight?
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLEEPING_CLOCKWORK_KNIGHT: At the end of your turn, equip 1 random Equipment card, then wake as the Clockwork Knight: at the end of each later turn, deal damage equal to [blue]{PerEquip}[/blue] × your Equipment count to a random enemy.

FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHOP_ORDER.title: Shop Order

FULLMOONKNIGHT-CARD_PACK.description: When you buy this, add {Cards:diff()} random cards to your deck.

FULLMOONKNIGHT-RED_ENVELOPE.description: Open it at once to gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold.
